import.title: Import transactions
import.intro: Upload a CSV file. Every row is checked first; nothing is stored until you confirm the preview. Files from German spreadsheets (semicolons, 1.234,56, 05.01.2026) work too.
import.fileHint: Columns: date, portfolio, type, isin or symbol + exchange (MIC), quantity, price, currency, fees, taxes, amount, note; optional fx_rate and split_ratio. At most 2 MB.
import.confirm: Import {count, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}}
import.blocked: Fix the rows marked above and check the file again. Nothing has been stored.
import.done: {transactions, plural, one {# transaction} other {# transactions}} imported, {portfolios, plural, =0 {no new portfolio} one {# new portfolio} other {# new portfolios}}.
import.error_too_large: The file is larger than 2 MB.
import.error_expired: The preview has expired. Please check the file again.
import.issue_number: "{column}" is not a valid number here.
import.issue_date: The date is not valid (use 2026-01-05 or 05.01.2026).
import.issue_type: Unknown type. Use buy, sell, dividend, transfer_in, transfer_out or split (exchange_out/exchange_in come from exports).
import.issue_security: The security was not found. Check the ISIN, or symbol and exchange (MIC such as XNYS).
import.issue_currency: The currency must be a three-letter code such as EUR.
import.issue_not_allowed: "{column}" is not allowed for this type.
import.issue_too_many_rows: The file has more than 5,000 rows.
import.issue_oversell: This sells more shares than are held on that date.
import.issue_oversell_held: This sells more shares than are held on that date (held: {held}).
import.issue_fx_missing: There is no exchange rate for {currency} on {date}. Add an fx_rate column.
import.issue_future: The date lies in the future.
import.issue_duplicate: This looks like a transaction that is already stored; it would be imported a second time.
import.issue_ambiguous: Two of your portfolios have this name. Rename one of them first.
import.issue_unpaired: A merger needs one exchange_out and one exchange_in row with the same link and date.
import.issue_invalid_row: This row does not fit the transactions already stored.

settings.title: Settings
settings.baseCurrencyHint: All values are shown in this currency.
settings.baseCurrencyLocked: Fixed once transactions exist: their exchange rates convert into this currency.
settings.timezoneHint: Decides where a day begins for dates and returns.
settings.dataHint: Download all your transactions as CSV, or add more from a file.
settings.deleteHint: Deletes your login, all portfolios and all transactions. This cannot be undone; export your data first if you want to keep it.
settings.error_baseCurrency_has_transactions: The base currency cannot change once transactions exist.
settings.error_confirm_mismatch: The e-mail address does not match. Nothing was deleted.
settings.error_delete_last_admin: You are the only administrator. Make someone else an administrator before deleting your account.
settings.devicesHint: TVs you paired show your portfolios read-only.
settings.deviceRemoveConfirm: Remove {name}? It stops showing your portfolios.

invite.title: You are invited
invite.body: Someone invited you to this Portfolio Viewer. Create an account (or sign in) and accept the invitation.
invite.invalid: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Ask for a new one.

admin.title: Members
admin.inviteHint: Creates a link that works once within 7 days. Send it yourself, for example by e-mail or messenger.
admin.inviteCreated: Invite link for {email}. It is shown only now:
admin.inviteError_invalid: Please enter a valid e-mail address.
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete {email} with all portfolios and transactions? This cannot be undone.

dashboard.valueChartLabel: Value over the selected time range
dashboard.hypothetical: Hypothetical: today's holdings at past prices
dashboard.hypotheticalNote: What your current holdings would have been worth on each day of the time range. Buys, sells and dividends in between are left out, and so are securities without a current price. The line begins once every security has a price.
dashboard.hypotheticalChartLabel: Value of today's holdings at past closing prices over the selected time range
dashboard.comparisonChartLabel: Change in percent of the portfolio and the benchmarks over the selected time range
dashboard.benchmarkNote: Benchmarks are euro-listed ETFs on Xetra, converted into your base currency. Returns are time-weighted, so deposits and withdrawals do not count as gains.
dashboard.noHistory: No price history yet. Charts appear once prices for your securities have been loaded.

pair.title: Pair a TV
pair.intro: Open the Portfolio Viewer TV page on the TV (or in the TV app). It shows a code; type it here.
pair.name: Device name
pair.nameHint: So you can tell your TVs apart in the settings.
pair.paired: The TV is paired. It continues by itself in a few seconds.
pair.error_not_found: This code is unknown or has expired. Check the TV for the current code.
pair.error_throttled: Too many wrong codes. Try again in 15 minutes.
pair.error_name: Enter a device name with 1 to 40 characters.
pair.manage: Manage paired TVs in the settings
pair.warning: Only enter a code shown on a screen in front of you: that screen will show all your portfolios until you remove it in the settings.

tv.pairTitle: Show your portfolios on this screen
tv.pairStep1: On your phone or computer, open
tv.pairReadOnly: This screen will only show your portfolios. Nothing can be changed from it, and you can remove it any time in the settings.
tv.pairBusy: The server is busy. A new code follows in a moment.
tv.empty: No holdings yet. Record your first purchase in Portfolio Viewer on your phone or computer.
